description: Servizio Idrico 2020 - View Service is a dataset listed in Italian Catalogue of metadata for Spatial Data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by informambiente.mase.gov.it. Download service and request data collected by ARERA and provided by the operators of the national water service for 2020 relating to water losses of aqueducts, water quality of aqueducts, the adequacy of the sewage system, the disposal of sludge in landfills and the quality of reclaimed water in landfills. Coverage: IT. The portal shows the English title as "Water Service 2020 - View Service" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include WFD, open data, Hydrography. The listing shows 1 download or service links in WMS. The listing shows 2020-01-30 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-rndt.
